analysis_md:
由题意知，环量为 $\oint_L(xy^2+e^x\cos y)\mathbf i+(x^2y-e^x\sin y)\mathbf j$

$P=xy^2+e^x\cos y,Q=x^2y-e^x\sin y$

$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=2xy-e^x\sin y,\quad \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=2xy-e^x\sin y$

$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$

所以 $\oint_L(xy^2+e^x\cos y)\mathbf i+(x^2y-e^x\sin y)\mathbf j=0$
